outcome: outcomes of neonates with disseminated HSV infection
finding: Disseminated HSV infection in neonates is challenging to diagnose and is associated with high mortality, particularly in cases with respiratory disease and delayed acyclovir treatment.
mod_finding: Eleven out of twenty-two neonates with disseminated herpes simplex virus infection were delivered by cesarean delivery, with three of those not experiencing prolonged rupture of membranes.
